theme_strategy: Light theme primary for optimal daytime readability in a shop environment. High contrast and clean numbers.

headings.usage: Dashboard titles, KPI numbers, Chart titles

body.usage: Table data, item names, rate inputs, labels

rules: No generic sans (Inter, Roboto) for headings.
Numbers in KPI cards MUST use tight letter spacing: tracking-tight.
Table headers MUST be uppercase + tiny + wide spacing (tracking-[0.15em]).
Values representing currency must use a monospaced variant or tabular numerals if possible.
Use Accent Money (#10B981) specifically for positive revenue trends and total rupees.
Tint neutral greys with a tiny bit of warmth.
Ensure text meets APCA/WCAG AA contrast ratios.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
Cards: Flat solid backgrounds with subtle 1px border (border-black/5) and soft ambient shadow (shadow-sm).
No glassmorphism for data tables or forms to maintain utmost clarity.
Headers: Solid Background with a hard bottom border.
Tables: Dense padding (p-2 or p-3) for rows to allow high information density. Use sticky headers.
Inputs (Rate field): Right-aligned text for numbers. Hide HTML spin buttons. On focus, add ring-2 ring-primary/50.
KPI Cards: Include an icon on the top right (muted), large number in the middle, and an optional trend at the bottom.
PDF Upload: Drag-and-drop zone with clear dotted border and Phosphor FilePdf icon.

bento_rules: Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
Summary KPIs: col-span-1 (Total Revenue, Total Pcs, Active Days, Top Item).
Primary Data (Daily Sales Trend Chart): col-span-2 xl:col-span-3.
Secondary Data (Top Items Bar Chart): col-span-1 xl:col-span-1.
Ensure all cards stretch to fill height using h-full.

rules: Hover states on table rows: background highlight (bg-black/5 or bg-white/5).
Focus states: form inputs must have clear focus rings.
Charts: Smooth drawing animation on load (Recharts default).
Do not apply `transition: all`. Use specific transitions for opacity, colors, and transform.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='upload-pdf-btn').
Currency values must have the ₹ symbol explicitly prefixed.
Support prefers-reduced-motion for chart animations.
Ensure all form inputs (Rates) have aria-labels.

icons.style: Regular or Duotone weight for business dashboard clarity.

image_urls.description: Indian small business owner - Use as an optional avatar placeholder or welcome screen background if an empty state is needed.

3d_libraries.decision: None required. Use standard 2D Recharts for the Daily Sales line chart and Top Items bar charts.

instructions_to_main_agent.phase_1_setup: Install Recharts, Phosphor Icons, and Sonner. Set up UI skeleton with a Month Selector in the Top Header.
instructions_to_main_agent.phase_2_upload_parsing: Implement the PDF Upload logic. Since we don't have a real backend parser, mock the parsing of 'Apple Notes PDF format' to generate date-wise entries (e.g. 1-6, Watchstar, 5 pcs).
instructions_to_main_agent.phase_3_entry_manager: Create an 'Entry Manager' section or Data Table view showing all parsed daily entries. Crucial: Add an editable 'Rate' input column per row. When updated, it must auto-calculate the row total (Rate * Pcs) and update global dashboard totals immediately.
instructions_to_main_agent.phase_4_dashboard_kpis: Build the 4-card KPI strip: Monthly Total Revenue (₹), Total Pcs, Active Days, Top Item (by pcs or revenue).
instructions_to_main_agent.phase_5_charts: Implement Daily Sales Trend (Line Chart: X=Date, Y=Revenue) and Top Items (Bar Chart: X=Item Name, Y=Revenue/Pcs).
instructions_to_main_agent.phase_6_summary_table: Add an 'Item-wise Monthly Summary' table showing Item Name | Total Pcs | Total Revenue.
instructions_to_main_agent.note: Keep item names as-is (no normalization). Implement multi-month state support so the user can switch between months via the header.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use 'sonner' for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
